cases.scenario: A reviewed offline resolver chooses a same-name untrusted fixture candidate despite an internal-source requirement.
cases.expected_decision: Confirm source-selection behavior and clearly state whether the real package-manager path was exercised.

cases.scenario: The supported install path accepts only the approved artifact digest/source and rejects the substitute.
cases.expected_decision: Treat the tested install boundary as protected; inspect update paths separately.

cases.scenario: A public registry contains the same name, but the application resolver and source restrictions are unknown.
cases.expected_decision: Keep confusion as a hypothesis; do not publish or claim package names to obtain proof.
